config_name: MacBook Pro 16-inch — M5 Pro 18-core CPU / 20-core GPU, 24GB RAM, 2TB SSD

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard, Touch ID, Force Touch trackpad

battery.notes: 100Wh; 140W adapter. Storage tier does not materially change runtime.

price.notes: Verified on apple.com/ca buy page; 1→2TB is +$750 (see research/parts/apple/NOTES.md).

reviews.quote: Apple also includes Wi-Fi 7 as well as much faster PCIe 5.0 SSDs.
premium workstation laptop designed for creative and professional work

praises: 2TB of PCIe 5.0 flash keeps full 8K/RAW libraries local at fast speeds (NBC SSD benchmarks)
M5 Pro runs at full sustained power in this chassis — no throttling (NBC)
Thunderbolt 5 for docks and external arrays (NBC)
Best laptop display and speakers Apple makes, matte option available (NBC)
Very quiet even during long exports (NBC)
complaints: +$750 CAD per terabyte — memory and SSD upgrades are more expensive than ever (NBC and Tom's Hardware)
Prices are still high, especially when you add upgrades (NBC con)
Still no SD Express support in the card reader (NBC con)
Battery runtime slightly below the M4 Pro generation (NBC)
Soldered RAM/SSD: capacity must be bought up front, and 2.14 kg is a commute tax

design_philosophy: The capacity tier of the sensible 16-inch: the same full-power M5 Pro with double the soldered storage for creators who live in Resolve, Lightroom, and Xcode. It's the desk-first workstation build before you start paying for Max-tier graphics.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC's directly tested 16-inch M5 Pro 1TB config (92.3%): +0.2 creative_work for the 2TB working-library capacity. Sentiment synthesized from pro reviews — Reddit API blocked (403).
